court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Maharaj Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another

parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and Another (wife, police)

facts_of_case: The wife lodged an FIR against the husband alleging harassment for dowry after marriage. Police submitted a charge sheet which is under challenge.

legal_principles.principle: A Hindu marriage is not valid unless performed in accordance with the applicable rites or ceremonies.
legal_principles.held: Where a Hindu marriage is not performed in accordance with the applicable rites or ceremonies such as saptapadi when included, the marriage will not be construed as a Hindu marriage.
cited_cases: Dolly Rani Vs. Manish Kumar Chanchal, (2025) 2 SCC 587

legal_principles.principle: Registration of a Hindu marriage under the Hindu Marriage Registration Rules does not confer legitimacy to an invalid marriage.
legal_principles.held: But if there has been no marriage in accordance with Section 7, the registration would not confer legitimacy to the marriage.
cited_cases: Dolly Rani Vs. Manish Kumar Chanchal, (2025) 2 SCC 587

legal_principles.principle: A certificate issued under the Hindu Marriage Registration Rules is prima facie proof of a valid Hindu marriage.
legal_principles.held: The above marriage certificate facilitates prima facie proof of factum of marriage.

outcome.final_order: The entire criminal proceeding pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 3, Bareilly relating to Case No. 398/2024 is quashed.

use_for_drafting: quashing criminal proceeding in dowry harassment case
advising client on validity of Arya Samaj marriage
